sloka: स त्वमिन्द्राशनिप्रख्यैः शरैरवकिरन् परान्।अभिद्रवाशु यावद्वै नैतत् कर्म समाप्यते ।। ६.८६.४ ।।
transliteration: sa tvamindrāśaniprakhyaiḥ śarairavakiran parān।abhidravāśu yāvadvai naitat karma samāpyate ।। 6.86.4 ।।

translations.english: "You have come to attack the enemy. Before he completes his action quickly attack him with the thunderbolt of Indra."
